rationale.because: R-014, R-015: Portfolio Q&A agent answers credit officers' questions spanning active deals, grounded in stored deal data and traceable to deal records
R-003, R-058: Display the status of every deal at every workflow stage with deal list, search, and filter capability grouped by workflow stage
R-025, R-049: Every agent output requires explicit human acceptance before workflow proceeds; human review UI shows draft alongside citations with accept, edit, and reject actions
R-051: Expose a per-deal audit timeline view so reviewers and auditors can read the full history of state changes, calculations, agent drafts, and human decisions in order
R-034: Surface deals idle for more than 5 business days on an SLA dashboard
